### 2026-10-08 – This was in the 10/6 and it was the first time of me doing anything to do with PCB so I was pretty confused while reading the Starbie guide(I also didn't know about the timelapses). I also  watched so

**6.48h**

This was in the 10/6 and it was the first time of me doing anything to do with PCB so I was pretty confused while reading the Starbie guide(I also didn't know about the timelapses). I also  watched some tutorials from youtube while Kicad downloaded(I have a pretty bad internet). When I did start it went well with the schematics even though it took me a lot more than it should have because I had to google up lots of things I didn't know how to do. The biggest problem in schmatics was assigning foorprints since some of them I couldn't see, I tried solving this for a while but at the end I just downloaded some foorprints from other sites. The PCB editor wasn't so bad but I did ra with some problems with the foreign footprints I downloaded, I think that cause the next problem which was the cable management/position. In the end I decided that it was fine despite some errors that I fixed in the future. At last I downloaded Arduino IDE and did the first part of the instructions, which took a while to do cause of my bad internet. It was 11pm at this pint so I just called it a day and modified the PCB editor one last time before logging off.

### 2026-10-11 – This session started on 10/10 at around 6:30. I decided to work/learn on the code in Arduino IDE. The first hour I was trying to figure out how to download hackatime in IDE, it didn't work. For some r

**5h**

This session started on 10/10 at around 6:30. I decided to work/learn on the code in Arduino IDE. The first hour I was trying to figure out how to download hackatime in IDE, it didn't work. For some reason the files didn't appear in the pluggin of arduino, I disn't know why so I gave up after trying for a long time. After I decide to start researching some videos that could teach me how to understand the code given to me. I used AI to explain it to me which did work very well. I also had to modify the GPIO#s of my components since they didn't match up. Then I worked on integrating some code to practice. Supposed to be that the pet would have different expressions depending on it stats(I did NOT used AI to write code, only to ask for advice/help). Last hour 1.5 was me trying to fix a bug in the website I was usign to test my code "WOKWI" which said that it didn't see the mpu6050 model. Then I was interrupted by a keyboard "seizure". Long story short, I had written a WHOLE another day of working in Github. But then suddently my keyboard just decided to have a "seizure", never have I seen something like that happen. One moment I was coding and fixing a problem, and then the other NONE of my keyboard worked, the letter "W" closed my tabs, another one open file explorer, another open search history. I have NO IDEA what happen and I was left with my empty desktop since it wipedout my WHOLE tabs. I had to fully reset my computer to have control of my keyboard again. Today I want to fix the problem with WOKWI.

### 2026-10-11 – At the start of the session I was able to get rid of the "Guru Meditation error" but it still didn't work.

**3h**

At the start of the session I was able to get rid of the "Guru Meditation error" but it still didn't work.

After like an hour I was able to finally see an animation of the pet, I was very happy that I was able to do it, AI did help me, but I DID NOT copy & paste directly from it. Only used it for guidance and review my code once in a while.

![pet moving](https://halflife.hackclub-assets.com/hackclub-half-life/sessions/YxeITDl7iwgoT6DLD2VxfBSVHgDaGVtR/84e603af225bf8272c1b043088c9549643d70ecb64bab86509263a503390dede.png)

There is a little ball next to the pet that blinks, I don't know what it is, but It doesn't affect the program so Im gonna keep it for now.

The last thing I did was that I added vibratons based on the mpu6050. The AI did give me this idea, but I DID NOT copy & pasted code from it. I only used it for guidance.
I also had to watch videos explain how the stuff works, but I was able to do it. I can't show it since it is only screenshots, so basically when the acceleration is high the pet shakes more aggressively, and when the acceleration is low the shakes are minimun/gone.
